parole.testo: Perhaps from French caillette (“a frivolous gossip”), or Irish caile (“girl”).

parole.significato: A small horse-drawn carriage for hire; a hackney carriage.
parole.testo: Borrowed from French fiacre. From Hôtel de Saint Fiacre, a tavern in Paris operating a horse-carriage service from the 1640s, itself named after the Irish Saint Fiacre (c. 600–670 CE), perhaps from Irish fiach (“raven”).
